newsitem.title: USA: Clinton FY98 budget to propose aid to DC - OMB aide.
newsitem.headline: Clinton FY98 budget to propose aid to DC - OMB aide.

text.p: President Clinton will make "important proposals" aimed at helping the financially strapped Distict of Columbia in his upcoming fiscal year 1998 proposed budget, a spokesman said.

"The president is quite serious about wanting to address some of the structural problems that face the District in its relationship with the federal government," Lawrence Haas, associate director of communications at OMB, said in a telephone interview.
"You should expect to see important proposals in his fiscal 1998 budget," Haas said.
Clinton is scheduled to send his budget package to Capitol Hill by February 3.
Clinton pledged on December 13 that he will make a "serious effort" to assist the troubled city, following a hard-hitting report about city finances from its five-member financial control board.
However, he never "definitively" said that he would have proposals ready in time for his FY 1998 budget proposal, Haas said. "But you should expect to see some," Haas said.
